title: How Nivoda Doubled Revenue YoY After Implementing Hyperbound
summary: How Nivoda doubled revenue year over year after its outbound team started practicing with Hyperbound.
body_markdown:
## At a glance


> “If I was competing on a deal and the rep on the other side had Hyperbound and I didn’t, I would be nervous.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance


The problem


## When growth outpaces coaching bandwidth


Nivoda’s sales team has been growing fast. It was expanding from roughly 20 reps to 40, and the company needed to ramp large cohorts of new hires quickly.


1. 01


Manager bandwidth quickly became the bottleneck.


2. 02


The systems used to train and coach reps weren’t built for that kind of scale.


3. 03


If reps weren’t fully prepared before getting on the phone, opportunities were lost.


Nivoda sells exclusively to diamond and jewelry retailers, a niche market where every conversation matters. Outbound was already a primary driver of growth, so the quality of each call directly affected revenue.


> “We found that manager bandwidth just was not high enough to deliver the quality of role play that we needed to get our team trained up and sounding the way we wanted them to sound on calls.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance


The solution


## The moment roleplay became scalable


Instead of relying on managers to run repetitive roleplays, the team could simulate realistic buyer conversations and give consistent feedback at scale. Nivoda built structured learning modules tied to specific parts of the sales process, from objection handling to demo preparation to confirmation calls.


01


Use case


Practice


### Onboarding rebuilt around a bootcamp


Nivoda rebuilt its onboarding around a Hyperbound bootcamp. Reps practice cold openers, objection handling, and full call flows before touching real leads.


Nivoda onboarded about 30 hires in roughly six weeks. Reps certify before they touch real leads, so the team doesn’t burn a finite lead pool on practice.


> “If this actually works, if we can simulate our customer calls, provide feedback in real time, and certify reps before they go live, there’s basically no limit to how many reps we can onboard.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance


02


Use case


Practice


### One coaching philosophy across three regions


The AI gives consistent coaching across North America, EMEA, and APAC, scaling Nivoda’s training philosophy globally while keeping it personal.


With Hyperbound’s Resume Call feature, reps return to the exact moments they struggled and practice until they get it right. Managers spend their time on strategy instead of repetitive roleplays.


> “The AI gives the same feedback I would’ve given. It’s a little eerie how accurate it is. Hyperbound helped us encode our philosophy into a scalable system.”


Louis Zahawi Eid, VP of Commercial


03


Use case


Practice


### A competitive advantage on every call


Two years later, Hyperbound remains embedded in Nivoda’s sales motion. Reps use the platform daily to practice conversations, refine messaging, and improve before live calls.


Instead of relying solely on manager bandwidth, reps now get consistent feedback that helps them improve from one call to the next.


> “When reps see that something actually helps them perform better and helps them make more money, adoption takes care of itself.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance


Hyperbound’s impact


## From practice to pipeline


The impact showed up quickly in Nivoda’s outbound metrics. Before Hyperbound, when a rep reached a decision-maker, they booked a demo roughly 20% of the time. Today, that number is closer to 50%.


> “So when our outbound team picks up the phone and reaches a decision maker, about half the time we’re able to book a demo.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance


In the first three months alone, Nivoda saw 30% more demos booked, ramp time cut by 50%, and significant improvements in top-of-funnel conversion.


Because outbound was already a major driver of revenue, those improvements compounded across the business. Nivoda has doubled revenue year over year, driven largely by the strength of its outbound engine.


Leadership time went back to strategy: Rob to go-to-market planning and new subscription products, Louis to lead scoring and market sizing.


> “If we didn’t have sales reps who were trained properly, learning how to handle objections, run the best demos, and capture attention when they pick up the phone and cold call, that revenue growth wouldn’t have been available to us.”


Rob Rangel, Director of Sales Performance
